positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Our mission is to create a world where work empowers a better life.

We’re making the most complicated, impersonal business tasks simple and personal. Imagine payroll that brings everyone peace of mind, HR that transforms work into a community, and benefits that help people plan for a better future. That’s what we’re building at Gusto.

To learn more about life at Gusto, visit gusto.com/careers. We’re hiring in San Francisco and Denver!

positions.title: Founding Engineer
positions.description: Investor onboarding for companies raising money under Regulation D 506(b) and 506(c)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Mobile (iOS), frontend (react) and backend for patient management in hospitals.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: iOS developer working on the patient facing mobile app. Architected and implemented the "Health Record" feature from the ground up. This included developing modular and testable iOS components for the novel UX of the feature, developing the model layer for the feature using CoreData, as well developing the backend API for client consumption using ruby on rails.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description: We're a fitness tracker app that integrates with other trackers/wearables (RunKeeper, Fitbit, Jawbone, etc.) so that you can interact with your friends regardless of what trackers you guys use. Create competitive or collaborative challenges with each other to keep you and your friends motivated to workout. After a workout, you can send a short video taunt to your friends to either motivate them to workout or make fun of them :).

positions.title: Xcode QA Engineer
positions.description: Developing automation infrastructure to improve the quality of Xcode. Created and executed test plans, implemented scripting libraries to improve reliability of tests, ease difficulty of  developing tests easier and more reliably track performance in the product over time. Supported Xcode's iOS support, build system and app submission. Worked cross-functionally to ensure quality of the user experience from starting a new project to submission to the app store.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description:
Studying the symmetrical embeddings of regular maps of different genuses, and trying to discover physical, symmetrical embeddings of Conder's list of regular maps. Designed an mplemented a program to extract connectivity information from regular maps efficiently using Java. Currently working on efficiently building connectivity graphs, using the previously mentioned connectivity information, for low genus objects. 

                                  Skills
                                  C, C++, Java, Python, Obj-C, Android, Scheme, HTML, CSS, JQuery, OpenGL,
                                  wireshark
